bullets.text: Copilot Enhancements Roll Out - **Microsoft** introduces real-time text editing features in Copilot for Windows Insiders.
Microsoft Store Milestones - Over 250 million monthly users enjoy a more personalized **Microsoft Store** experience in 2025.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New features and improvements are available in the latest **Windows 11** Insider build.
AI-Ready Security Solutions - **Microsoft** emphasizes unified security platforms to combat evolving cyber threats in its new e-book.
Access Fabric Introduced - **Microsoft** unveils a unified approach to identity and network access security.
CVE-2025-55182 Vulnerability Alert - Critical RCE vulnerability in **React Server Components** poses significant risks.
Generative AI Defense Leader - **Microsoft** recognized as a leader in KuppingerCole's report for AI security capabilities.
